hypothesis.claim: The persisted component-preset document must reject contradictory or ambiguous structure before it becomes an in-memory catalog.
hypothesis.trigger: duplicate IDs/keys, invalid tombstones, version coercion, top-level omission/extension, alias conflicts, or override/remove overlap
hypothesis.expected_baseline: invalid states are accepted, last-wins silently, or page/detail disagree
hypothesis.expected_candidate: all covered contradictions raise ComponentPresetPersistenceError while valid built-in and tombstone compatibility remains
hypothesis.falsifier: any covered malformed case is accepted, silently overwritten, or published as a partially contradictory catalog

implementation: reject unknown/missing top-level fields and non-exact integer version
reject duplicate JSON keys and non-finite numeric constants during load
parse records before dict construction and reject duplicate IDs
reject persisted wrapper and conflicting alias fields
activation_checks: parent-commit matrix reproduced silent last-wins, scalar tombstones, version coercion, and page/detail inconsistency
candidate matrix rejects every covered contradiction with ComponentPresetPersistenceError
valid built-in override/tombstone behavior remains available
H13 HTTP error envelope and client CRUD semantics remain unchanged
